attributes.description: Daily storage, transfer, and estimated cost from Backblaze B2 usage reports.

query.esql: FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE @timestamp == latest_day | STATS `Stored (latest report)` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_day = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE @timestamp == latest_day | STATS `Stored (latest report)` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Month-to-date cost` = projected * days / days_in_month | KEEP `Month-to-date cost`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Month-to-date cost` = projected * days / days_in_month | KEEP `Month-to-date cost`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Projected month cost` = projected | KEEP `Projected month cost`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Projected month cost` = projected | KEEP `Projected month cost`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Free egress used (projected)` = egress_projected_gb / (avg_stored_gb * 3.0) | KEEP `Free egress used (projected)`

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | WHERE DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp) == DATE_TRUNC(1 month, latest_report) | STATS gb_hours = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 1000000000.0, days = COUNT_DISTINCT(@timestamp), downloaded_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), month_start = MIN(DATE_TRUNC(1 month, @timestamp)) | EVAL days_in_month = DATE_DIFF("day", month_start, month_start + 1 month), avg_stored_gb = gb_hours / 24.0 / days, egress_projected_gb = downloaded_gb * days_in_month / days, projected = GREATEST(avg_stored_gb - 10.0, 0.0) * TO_DOUBLE(?price_per_tb) / 1000.0 + GREATEST(egress_projected_gb - avg_stored_gb * 3.0, 0.0) * 0.01 | EVAL `Free egress used (projected)` = egress_projected_gb / (avg_stored_gb * 3.0) | KEEP `Free egress used (projected)`
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Uploaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Downloaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb)
FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS `Downloaded` = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb)

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | STATS `Last upload` = MAX(CASE(backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb > 0, @timestamp, null)), `Last activity` = MAX(CASE(backblaze_b2.usage.api_txn_total > 0 OR backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb > 0, @timestamp, null)), latest_report = MAX(latest_report), Stored = SUM(CASE(@timestamp == latest_report, backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb, 0.0)) BY Bucket = entity.name | EVAL days_since_upload = DATE_DIFF("day", `Last upload`, latest_report), days_since_activity = DATE_DIFF("day", `Last activity`, latest_report), Status = CASE(`Last activity` IS NULL, "No activity in period", days_since_activity > 1, "Stale", `Last upload` IS NULL OR days_since_upload > 1, "Active, no new uploads", "Recent upload") | KEEP Bucket, Status, `Last upload`, `Last activity`, Stored | SORT `Last activity` ASC NULLS FIRST, Bucket

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | INLINE STATS latest_report = MAX(@timestamp) | STATS `Last upload` = MAX(CASE(backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb > 0, @timestamp, null)), `Last activity` = MAX(CASE(backblaze_b2.usage.api_txn_total > 0 OR backblaze_b2.usage.uploaded_gb > 0, @timestamp, null)), latest_report = MAX(latest_report), Stored = SUM(CASE(@timestamp == latest_report, backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb, 0.0)) BY Bucket = entity.name | EVAL days_since_upload = DATE_DIFF("day", `Last upload`, latest_report), days_since_activity = DATE_DIFF("day", `Last activity`, latest_report), Status = CASE(`Last activity` IS NULL, "No activity in period", days_since_activity > 1, "Stale", `Last upload` IS NULL OR days_since_upload > 1, "Active, no new uploads", "Recent upload") | KEEP Bucket, Status, `Last upload`, `Last activity`, Stored | SORT `Last activity` ASC NULLS FIRST, Bucket

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | STATS stored_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb) BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp), Bucket = entity.name | SORT day

FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" AND backblaze_b2.usage.scope == "bucket" | STATS stored_gb = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.stored_gb) BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp), Bucket = entity.name | SORT day

query.esql: FROM logs-backblaze_b2.usage-* | WHERE data_stream.dataset == "backblaze_b2.usage" | STATS Downloaded = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.downloaded_gb), gb_days = SUM(backblaze_b2.usage.storage_byte_hours) / 24.0 / 1000000000.0 BY day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp) | EVAL `Free egress allowance` = gb_days * 3.0 / 30.0 | KEEP day, Downloaded, `Free egress allowance` | SORT day
